dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Ahh, I'm stuffed! And this time, my tongue was safe from being burned by heat or spice! Thanks, Chongyun!

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: No trouble at all, Miss. With a well-stocked kitchen like Xiangling's, making a bowl of noodles is nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: See? What'd I say? Told you I knew someone who makes delicious cold dishes!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: That's right! Chongyun's signature dish, "Cold Noodles with Mountain Delicacies"! It's just perfect for Kirara!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: I was passing through the area when Xiangling came up to me. Said she had something really urgent she needed my help with, so I followed her... and wound up making a bowl of noodles with some sides for Miss Kirara.

choices.text: When you put it like that, thanks to his condition...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Yes, a... happy coincidence. I used one of my recipes to prepare a simple meal. Thankfully, it seems to suit Miss Kirara's tastes too.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Chongyun, c'mon! No need to act like a stranger! If you keep this up, I won't take you to see Ioroi or Itto!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Chongyun said he's always wanted to see supernatural creatures, but for some reason, he's never managed to.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Itto's a full-blooded Oni, and Ioroi's a proper great youkai... And it just so happens that I can make the introductions!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: G—Great youkai!? D—Do they... Um, Miss Kirara, what exactly are the spirits and monsters of Inazuma like? Do they ever harm people with magic?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If they're really fierce, I can always ask the Lan Yan from Chenyu Vale's Lan clan to help. Her family's Qimen Arts will definitely be able to subdue them!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Oh, right! And there's also my friend Xingqiu! His swordsmanship is top-notch, and he'll definitely help — that's just the sort of noble soul he is!

choices.text: Chongyun, buddy, about that... Calm down a sec.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hey, hey! Don't get the wrong idea, Chongyun! Ioroi and Itto are both good people... Err, good youkai.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: The worst — and I mean the absolute worst — thing that Itto's ever done is refusing to admit he lost a card game. He still owes me Tricolor Dango for that!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Ioroi is also nice, it just... Every time I pass through Chinju Forest, he drags me into playing hide-and-seek...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Huh? That... That's completely different from what I've read...

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Heehee. The books also say that everyone in Liyue stands on swords while they surf through the skies! Don't believe everything you read.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: That settles it! You're taking the boat with me in a few days. I'll take you to see them, and my Granny too!

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Very well. I'll start getting ready now. Ah, right, and I'll need to bring my youkai booklet too...

choices.text: Those two aren't the kind of supernatural creatures you're thinking of.
Chongyun can't handle hot or spicy foods either.
